definitions.gloss: career advancement; promotion; getting ahead at work
definitions.explanation: rising in one's career or position within an organization

definitions.gloss: success in life; rising in the world; making one's way up
definitions.explanation: achieving social or financial success, improving one's status in society

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{若|わか}くして{出世|しゅっせ}した。
examples.english: He advanced in his career at a young age.

examples.japanese: {出世|しゅっせ}のために{残業|ざんぎょう}を{厭|いと}わない。
examples.english: I don't mind working overtime for career advancement.

examples.japanese: {出世|しゅっせ}コースから{外|はず}れてしまった。
examples.english: I fell off the fast track for promotion.

examples.japanese: {田舎|いなか}から{出|で}てきて{出世|しゅっせ}した。
examples.english: He came from the countryside and made it big.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{芸能界|げいのうかい}で{出世|しゅっせ}した。
examples.english: She rose to success in the entertainment industry.

examples.japanese: {出世|しゅっせ}{払|ばら}いで{借金|しゃっきん}を{返|かえ}す{約束|やくそく}をした。
examples.english: I promised to pay back the debt when I make it big.

notes:
FORMATION:
{出|しゅつ} (exit, emerge) + {世|せ} (world) → emerge into the world

VERB FORM:
{出世|しゅっせ}する (to advance in one's career)

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {出世|しゅっせ}コース (fast track for promotion)
- {出世|しゅっせ}{街道|かいどう} (path to success)
- {出世|しゅっせ}{払|ばら}い (paying back when successful)
- {出世|しゅっせ}{頭|がしら} (person risen to high position)
- {出世|しゅっせ}{魚|うお} (fish whose name changes as it grows)

{出世|しゅっせ}{魚|うお}:
Some fish like {鰤|ぶり} (yellowtail) are called {出世|しゅっせ}{魚|うお} because their names change as they grow larger, symbolizing advancement.

WORK CULTURE:
In traditional Japanese corporate culture ({年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}), {出世|しゅっせ} was largely based on seniority. Modern companies increasingly emphasize merit-based promotion.
